mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `farm_chat_message` (session_id, sender_id, receiver_id, message_type, content, media_url, is_read, status) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{messageType}, #{content}, #{mediaUrl}, #{isRead}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `farm_chat_message` WHERE media_url = #{mediaUrl} AND status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE `farm_chat_message` SET is_read = 1, read_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0 AND status = 1
